Layout.metadataDescription: Paste an App Store link or App ID. We fetch subscription prices across 35 regions in real time, convert to a single currency, and rank them lowest first.

HomePage.heroSubtitle: Subscription prices across {count} regions, sorted cheapest first — see the lowest at a glance.
HomePage.regionsDesc: From the US to Japan, Turkey to India — real-time pricing across dozens of countries, converted to your currency in one click. The cheapest region is right there.
HomePage.faqA1: All data comes from public App Store pages, covering {count} regions and converted at current exchange rates. Updated every 6 hours.
HomePage.faqA2: Monthly / yearly subscriptions, one-time purchases, Family Sharing — any IAP shown on the App Store detail page.
HomePage.faqA3: We only store the Apps you add. Sign-in is used solely to sync your membership status; no other personal data is collected.
HomePage.faqQ4: Which App Store region is the cheapest?
HomePage.faqA4: The lowest-price region differs per App. Paste a link and we'll fetch subscription prices across {count} regions, convert to a single currency, and rank them — the cheapest stands out.
HomePage.faqQ5: How do I check App Store prices across countries?
HomePage.faqA5: Paste an App Store link or App ID into the input on the Apps page and hit enter to compare IAP and subscription prices across {count} regions.
